name: Shaka Time Hawaii
old_description: Discover authentic Hawaiian clothing designed to bring the spirit of the islands into everyday life. At Shaka Time, we offer premium aloha wear inspired by Hawaii’s culture, color, and relaxed elegance. Since 1991, our brand has helped customers shop island-ready style with Hawaii-made clothing, timeless tropical prints, and comfortable silhouettes for men, women, and families.
about:
Shaka Time Hawaii is based in Honolulu, Hawaii, and has been operating since 1991. The company began as a brand offering authentic Hawaiian clothing crafted in Honolulu, focusing on premium aloha wear inspired by the islands' culture and relaxed elegance.

The company designs and sells a range of Hawaiian apparel including men's aloha shirts (cotton, rayon, palaka), women's dresses (short, midi, maxi, muumuu), children's clothing, matching family sets, wedding attire, accessories (leis, hair accessories, purses, jewelry), and performance socks. Products are described as Hawaii-made, with fabrics such as rayon and cotton. Shaka Time operates an e-commerce site with gift-wrapping service and free U.S. shipping on orders over $69.

Shaka Time serves individual consumers seeking vacation, luau, beach wedding, and everyday tropical wear, as well as groups and wedding parties through its group-order program. Its collections span men's, women's, and children's sizes, plus matching couples and family outfits, and even dog shirts.

The company emphasizes quality craftsmanship, island-inspired design, and genuine Hawaii-made apparel that reflects the warmth and heritage of the islands, positioning itself as a source for authentic aloha wear that combines comfort with cultural authenticity.
